title: FrameScript project file (.fscr), schema version 4
description: JSON document written by FrameScript when it saves a project. One file is one project. Strings are UTF-8 JSON strings; dates are RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 strings; UUIDs are canonical UUID strings; binary values are base64 strings.
$comment: Forward compatibility: every object in this schema allows unknown properties (additionalProperties is true or a value schema for maps). The Swift reader ignores unknown keys and drops them when it re-writes a file, so a round-trip through the macOS app is not byte-preserving. Writers that need to keep data from newer builds should preserve unknown members themselves. Files with a fileVersion above 4 must be rejected instead of being interpreted as v4.

fileVersion.description: Schema version of this document. Writers always emit 4. Readers accept 1 through 4 and migrate older documents in memory; a larger value means the file was written by a newer build and must be rejected.

Project.description: One video project: the script, its production data and its local publishing metadata.

id.description: Stable project identifier. Foundation writes uppercase UUID strings; readers must accept any letter case.

title.description: Project title as shown in the library.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Written as an ISO-8601 instant in UTC with six fractional digits, for example 2024-01-01T10:00:00.000000Z.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp. Defaults to createdAt when absent in older files.

templateID.description: Optional identifier of the template this project was created from.

settingsOverride.description: Optional per-project overrides for application defaults.

exportPresets.description: Saved export presets. Order is presentation order and has no other meaning.

scenes.description: Scenes of the script. Sort by each scene's order field; do not rely on array order.

primaryLanguage.description: BCP-47 language code of the original script, for example "es". Defaults to "es" when absent.

topic.description: Free-form topic used for classification and filtering. Empty means unset.

videoType.description: Free-form video type used for classification, for example "review". Empty means unset.

productionStatus.description: Coarse production stage shown on the dashboard. Defaults to "idea".

targetDate.description: Optional date by which the video should be finished.

publishDate.description: Optional date the video is planned to be published.

targetDuration.description: Optional target duration of the finished video, in seconds.

learnedWordsPerMinuteByLanguage.description: Map from BCP-47 language code to the speech rate learned from recordings, in words per minute. JSON object with language codes as keys.

additionalProperties.description: Learned words per minute for one language.

learnedWordsPerMinuteResetAtByLanguage.description: Map from BCP-47 language code to the instant the user last reset the learned speech rate for that language. Takes recorded at or before this instant do not teach the learner. JSON object with language codes as keys.

publishingPacks.description: Map from BCP-47 language code to the publishing pack for that language. JSON object with language codes as keys.

comparisonTables.description: Free-form comparison tables used while researching.

glossary.description: Translation glossary, used to keep names and technical terms stable across languages.

clips.description: Short-form clips derived from this project.

versionHistory.description: Stored snapshots of earlier document states. Each payload is a SnapshotCodec envelope compressed with zlib and then base64-encoded; see docs/format/README.md.

aiThreadMap.description: Mapping between this project and T3 assistant threads.

unparsedSections.description: Sections of an imported Markdown file that the importer could not map to scenes. Preserved verbatim.

publishedVideos.description: Map from BCP-47 language code to the imported comparison of the published video in that language. JSON object with language codes as keys.

ProjectSettingsOverride.description: Per-project overrides for application defaults. Both members are optional; an empty object means "use defaults".

wordsPerMinute.description: Speaking rate override used for duration estimates.

defaultSplitMode.description: Default text segmentation mode for new scenes in this project.

RhythmThresholds.description: Per-project rhythm-review thresholds. Every member is optional; a missing member uses the application default.

longSentenceWordLimit.description: Sentences longer than this word count are flagged.

uncoveredSecondsLimit.description: Seconds of script text without any visual or editing note before a warning is shown.

sceneLengthRatioLimit.description: Maximum ratio between a scene's duration and the average scene duration.

hookSecondsLimit.description: Maximum duration, in seconds, that the hook may last before a warning is shown.

name.description: Display name of the preset. Defaults to an empty string.

format.description: Export format produced by this preset. Defaults to "Production outline".

Scene.description: One scene (beat) of the script, with its script text, segments and attached production notes.

id.description: Scene identifier. Must be unique within the project.

order.description: Zero-based position of the scene inside the project. Sort by this value; array order is not authoritative.

sectionType.description: Narrative role of the scene. Defaults to "Custom".

scriptText.description: Script text of the scene exactly as typed. Text anchors and segment offsets are measured in UTF-16 code units of this string.

textSegments.description: Segments of scriptText used for timing and navigation.

aiComments.description: Script-review comments, possibly produced by an assistant.

bRollItems.description: B-roll (visual) notes attached to this scene.

editingItems.description: Editing notes attached to this scene.

targetDuration.description: Optional target duration for this scene, in seconds.

takes.description: Recorded takes of the original-language script.

languageVariants.description: Translated versions of the scene. B-roll and editing notes stay shared with the original scene.

obsSceneName.description: Optional OBS scene that should be live while recording this scene.

TextSegment.description: A range of a scene's script text used for timing estimates and as an anchor target.

sceneID.description: Identifier of the owning scene. Must equal the enclosing scene's id.

order.description: Zero-based position of the segment within the scene.

sourceText.description: Trimmed text of the segment. Not necessarily a substring of scriptText: separators are removed and whitespace is normalized.

segmentType.description: Granularity used to split the scene. Defaults to "scene".

timingEstimate.description: Estimated spoken duration of the segment, in seconds.

AIComment.description: A script-review comment, optionally anchored to a scene or text segment.

sceneID.description: Optional scene the comment refers to.

segmentID.description: Optional text segment the comment refers to.

type.description: Free-form category tag such as "pacing" or "clarity". Empty means uncategorized.

severity.description: Importance of the comment. Defaults to "note".

status.description: Review state of the comment. Defaults to "new".

BRollItem.description: A B-roll (visual) note, attached either to a text anchor or to a text segment.

textAnchor.description: Optional anchor into the scene's scriptText.

linkedSegmentID.description: Optional text segment this note follows. Legacy v1 files stored only this link; the migration derives textAnchor from it.

templateType.description: Free-form template or shot type label, for example "wide".

sourceType.description: Kind of footage suggested. Defaults to "Custom".

duration.description: Planned duration in seconds. Zero means unspecified.

status.description: Sourcing state of the item. Defaults to "Idea".

EditingItem.description: An editing note, attached either to a text anchor or to a text segment.

textAnchor.description: Optional anchor into the scene's scriptText.

linkedSegmentID.description: Optional text segment this note follows.

templateType.description: Free-form template label for the note.

description.description: Cut style. Persisted under the historical key "description" so v1-v3 tooling can still read it. Writers must emit this key; readers should also accept the legacy alias "cutStyle" when "description" is absent.

cutStyle.description: Read-only legacy alias for "description". Accepted on input and ignored when both keys are present. Never written by FrameScript 4.

emphasis.description: Emphasis treatment, for example a punch-in or bold caption.

zoom.description: Zoom instruction, stored as free-form text such as "110%".

status.description: Whether the note has been applied. Defaults to "pending".

Take.description: One recorded take of a scene, in the original language or in a translated variant.

number.description: One-based take number shown to the creator. Defaults to 1.

startedAt.description: Recording start instant. Defaults to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z when absent.

filePath.description: Path of the recorded file, as shown to the user. Empty when the take has no file yet.

bookmarkData.description: Optional base64-encoded macOS security-scoped bookmark for filePath. Other platforms can ignore it and use filePath.

rating.description: Rating given while recording. Defaults to "unrated".

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language code of the spoken text. Empty means the scene's original language.

readText.description: Text that was shown in the teleprompter while recording this take.

sceneTextHash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the scene text at recording time, rendered as lowercase hexadecimal without zero padding. Used to detect stale takes.

SceneLanguageVariant.description: One translated version of a scene. Takes, durations and text are per language; B-roll and editing notes live on the original scene.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language code of this variant. Empty means unspecified.

sourceHash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the original scene text this translation was produced from. Compare with a fresh hash to detect stale translations.

takes.description: Recorded takes of this translated text.

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated spoken duration of the translated text, in seconds.

actualDuration.description: Measured duration of the recorded takes, in seconds.

TextAnchor.description: A selection inside a scene's scriptText. Offsets use UTF-16 code units, the same unit as JavaScript String.length, Java char indices and NSRange. The selected text plus a little surrounding context lets a reader relocate the selection after the script was edited.

startUTF16.description: Zero-based offset of the first selected UTF-16 code unit within scriptText.

lengthUTF16.description: Number of selected UTF-16 code units. May differ from selectedText.count when the text contains characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, such as emoji.

selectedText.description: The selected substring. Used as the primary repair key when the offset no longer matches.

prefixContext.description: Up to 48 UTF-16 code units immediately before the selection, snapped to composed character boundaries. Empty when the selection starts at the beginning of the text.

suffixContext.description: Up to 48 UTF-16 code units immediately after the selection, snapped to composed character boundaries. Empty when the selection ends at the end of the text.

ProjectAsset.description: A file referenced by the project, tracked independently of the scenes that use it.

path.description: Path of the file, as shown to the user.

bookmarkData.description: Optional base64-encoded macOS security-scoped bookmark for path. Other platforms can ignore it.

kind.description: Source tag for the asset. Defaults to "web".

linkedSceneIDs.description: Scenes that reference this asset. The migration drops identifiers that do not resolve.

linkedBRollItemIDs.description: B-roll items that reference this asset. The migration drops identifiers that do not resolve.

linkedTakeIDs.description: Takes recorded into this asset. The migration drops identifiers that do not resolve.

isCopiedIntoProject.description: True when the file was copied into the project instead of being referenced in place.

fileSize.description: Optional file size in bytes, as a signed 64-bit integer.

modifiedAt.description: Optional filesystem modification time recorded during the last check.

isLastKnownMissing.description: True when the last filesystem check could not find the file.

ChapterOverride.description: A manual override for one YouTube chapter.

sceneID.description: Optional scene this chapter is derived from.

title.description: Chapter title shown in the published video.

startSeconds.description: Optional manual start time of the chapter, in seconds from the beginning of the video.

isExcluded.description: True when this chapter should not be emitted.

ThumbnailVariant.description: A thumbnail candidate paired with a title idea.

assetID.description: Optional asset holding the thumbnail image.

pairedTitle.description: Title text that should be shown next to this thumbnail.

isChosen.description: True for the variant the creator picked.

PublishingPack.description: Everything needed to publish the video in one language.

pinnedComment.description: Comment to pin under the published video.

communityPost.description: Text for a community post announcing the video.

thumbnailConceptNotes.description: Free-form notes about the thumbnail concept.

kind.description: Category of the task. Defaults to "other".

isDone.description: True when the task is complete.

sceneID.description: Optional scene the task belongs to.

url.description: Source URL. Empty when the source is offline.

Claim.description: A factual claim that must be checked against sources before publishing.

sourceIDs.description: Sources that support or discuss the claim. The migration drops identifiers that do not resolve.

sceneIDs.description: Scenes where the claim is stated. The migration drops identifiers that do not resolve.

ComparisonTable.description: A free-form comparison table used while researching.

rows.description: Row-major cells. Rows are not required to have the same length as header.

GlossaryTerm.description: A term that must be translated consistently.

isProtected.description: True when the term must not be translated and should be copied verbatim.

ShortClip.description: A short-form clip derived from one or more scenes.

sourceSceneIDs.description: Scenes the clip is cut from.

anchorSceneID.description: Optional scene the anchor refers to. When set, anchor is measured inside that scene's scriptText.

adaptedText.description: Script adapted for the short format.

targetSeconds.description: Target duration in seconds. Defaults to 30.

onScreenText.description: Text that should appear on screen.

description.description: Caption or description for the published clip.

sourceHash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the source text the clip was adapted from, as lowercase hexadecimal without padding.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language code of the clip. Empty means the project's primary language.

sceneSourceHashes.description: Per-scene source hashes, used to detect stale clips after a scene was rewritten.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the clip. Defaults to "idea".

ShortClipSceneSourceHash.description: Hash of one scene's text at the time a clip was derived from it.

hash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the scene's scriptText, as lowercase hexadecimal without padding.

VersionSnapshot.description: One entry of the in-project version history. The payload is a compressed SnapshotCodec envelope, not plain JSON: base64-decode it, then inflate the zlib payload described in docs/format/README.md.

createdAt.description: Creation instant. Defaults to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z when absent.

name.description: Optional user-visible name. Absent for unnamed automatic snapshots.

isAutomatic.description: True when the snapshot was taken automatically.

label.description: Short free-form label, for example "manual". May be empty.

compressedPayload.description: Base64 of the SnapshotCodec envelope: 28-byte little-endian header (magic "FSSC", version 1, flags 0, two reserved zero bytes, uncompressed length, compressed length, CRC-32) followed by a zlib stream of the UTF-8 JSON document. Empty string for an empty payload.

AIThreadMap.description: Links this project to assistant threads maintained by T3.

t3ProjectID.description: T3 project identifier. Empty when the project is not linked.

threadIDsByProviderModel.description: Map from "provider/model" to thread identifier. JSON object with provider/model strings as keys.

UnparsedSection.description: A Markdown section preserved verbatim because the importer could not map it to scenes.

heading.description: Heading line of the section, without the leading "#" markers.

PublishedVideoComparison.description: Comparison between a published video and the planned script, imported from a transcript and retention report.

videoID.description: Platform identifier of the published video.

url.description: Public URL of the published video.

title.description: Title the video was published with.

importedAt.description: Instant the comparison was imported. Defaults to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z when absent.

PublishedVideoComparisonSceneResult.description: Comparison result for one scripted scene.

realStart.description: Start of the scene in the published video, in seconds.

realEnd.description: End of the scene in the published video, in seconds.

addedWords.description: Words spoken in the published video that are not in the script.

removedWords.description: Script words that were not spoken.

coverage.description: Fraction of the scripted scene that made it into the published video, 0 to 1.

avgRetention.description: Average retention during the scene, as a fraction 0 to 1.

dropMagnitude.description: How strongly retention dropped during the scene, as a fraction 0 to 1.

TranscriptSegment.description: One timed line of a published video's transcript.

start.description: Start time in seconds from the beginning of the video.

end.description: End time in seconds from the beginning of the video.

RetentionPoint.description: One sample of the audience-retention curve.

time.description: Seconds since the start of the published video.

percent.description: Percentage of viewers still watching at that time, 0 to 100. Fractional values are allowed.

SectionType.description: Narrative role of a scene. Raw values are persisted and must never change.

SegmentType.description: Granularity used to split a scene's script text into segments.

BRollSourceType.description: Kind of footage a B-roll note asks for. Raw values are persisted and must never change.

BRollStatus.description: Sourcing state of a B-roll item.

AICommentStatus.description: Review state of an assistant comment.

ExportFormat.description: Format produced by an export preset. Raw values are persisted and must never change.

EditingStatus.description: Whether an editing note has been applied.

ProductionStatus.description: Coarse production stage of the project.

TakeRating.description: Rating given to a recorded take.

AssetKind.description: Source tag for a project asset. Raw values are persisted and must never change.

ChecklistTaskKind.description: Category of a manual production task.

ShortClipFormat.description: Destination format of a short clip.

ShortClipStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a short clip.
